rows.note: For the positive feeling of satisfaction in oneself, one's achievements, work, or family, this is the all-purpose choice.

example.english: I take a lot of pride in my work.
example.traditional: 我對自己份工作好有自豪感。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 zi6 gei2 fan6 gung1 zok3 hou2 jau5 zi6 hou4 gam2

rows.note: Use this noun for exaggerated self-importance and the haughty behavior or treatment it produces.

example.english: His pride makes him look down on everyone, as if they know nothing.
example.traditional: 佢咁自大，成日當人哋乜都唔識。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gam3 zi6 daai6 sing4 jat6 dong3 jan4 dei6 mat1 dou1 m4 sik1

rows.note: Use this when a person or thing is presented as someone's source of pride, rather than for the feeling itself or for arrogance.

example.english: This trophy is the pride of our whole team.
example.traditional: 呢個獎係我哋全隊嘅驕傲。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zoeng2 hai6 ngo5 dei6 cyun4 deoi2 ge3 giu1 ngou6

rows.note: Use this ordinary noun phrase for a group of lions; Cantonese usually describes the group instead of using a special collective noun.

example.english: There is a pride of lions in the zoo.
example.traditional: 動物園入面有一群獅子。
example.jyutping: dung6 mat6 jyun4 jap6 min6 jau5 jat1 kwan4 si1 zi2
